required_equality_when_attached.body_instance_id: Embodiment occupancy equals adapter attachment state
required_equality_when_attached.attachment_generation: Embodiment occupancy equals adapter attachment state

profile_swap: Retains body_instance_id and advances generation in both adapter and occupancy.
replacement: Installs new body_instance_id and generation in both adapter and occupancy after durable commit.
persistence: Embodiment serializes occupancy identity and generation in snapshots.

restart_reconciliation.ledger_newer_than_snapshot: Rebind snapshot occupancy from the later authoritative attachment ledger event.
restart_reconciliation.same_or_older_ledger_with_mismatch: Fail closed as authoritative state conflict.
restart_reconciliation.legacy_snapshot_missing_occupancy: One-way migration binds from the valid authoritative attachment ledger.

habitat: No held-object reference may survive true replacement; replacement rejects before commit if one exists.
stale_reference_rule: Old body ID or generation cannot validate post-replacement manipulation or execution.
